title: Normalized fibre comparisons, common-stage descent and rank loci
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Write $A_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $B_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and $E_X=B_{E,X}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. These are the continuous completed coefficient sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete constructible integral categories with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their raw rationalizations $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their bounded localized standard t-structures [prop-weil-localized-tstructure], and the pair category $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the finite scalar functors $T_{L/E}$ and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

For every such scheme $Z$, use its finite-stage heart fibres $\omega_{\bar z,E}$ with normalized lattice-limit and fractional-map prescriptions [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness]. Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and put $\bar x=g\bar y$. Use the actual completed rational pullback and its restriction $g^*$ to standard hearts [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback, lem-per-adic-stratified-pullback-texact]. There are natural isomorphisms
$$\omega_{\bar y,E}(g^*F)\cong\omega_{\bar x,E}(F),\qquad
\omega_{\bar x,L}(T_{L/E}F)\cong\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)\otimes_E L.$$
On normalized etale systems the first comparison is the inverse limit of the finite-level pullback-stalk comparisons followed by inversion of $\varpi_E$. The second is the finite integral scalar-limit comparison followed by inversion of the uniformizers. They respect quotient transitions, identity morphisms, composition of scheme morphisms, successive coefficient extensions and their scalar associators; the square combining pullback with scalar extension commutes. These comparisons are independent of the local lattice charts.

There is an induced fibre functor on the common-stage heart [lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations] with value $\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)\otimes_E\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ on $(E,F)$. It is exact; the family of all such fibres is jointly conservative and detects zero morphisms and short exact complexes. The displayed pullback comparisons descend to these fibres.

Every finite-stage heart object admits a finite locally closed stratification on which its continuous realization is lisse, and on each such stratum $x\mapsto\dim_E\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)$ is well defined independently of the geometric point over $x$ and locally constant with finite image. Every geometric fibre over a fixed underlying point is isomorphic as an $E$-vector space, without a specified canonical isomorphism. The rank loci refine that stratification to a finite stratification, and the positive-rank strata give exactly the nonzero-fibre locus, a constructible subset [def-weil-constructible-subset]. These assertions also hold for common-stage heart objects with $E$ replaced by $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$; finite coefficient extension preserves ranks and the nonzero-fibre loci.

proof.text: Apply the normalized pullback lemma to the actual completed heart pullback. Its projected tower map is the germ comparison, and localization gives $\alpha_{g,F}$. Its fractional naturality and chart independence give a natural comparison on the whole finite-stage heart, with identity and scheme-composition equations.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6); Remark 6.8.15; finite pullback stalk normalization, Stacks Tag 03Q1, etale-cohomology.tex lemma-stalk-pullback(3)

proof.text: Apply the scalar-completion lemma to the same fibres and $\alpha$. Its finite ramified tower reconstructs $M\otimes_A\mathcal O_L$; after localization this is $M\otimes_A L=\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)\otimes_E L$, giving $\beta$. The prescribed tensor and germ formulas give all quotient, coefficient-composition and mixed equations and independence of charts.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4), Remark 6.8.15; finite scalar reconstruction and balanced tensor associators

proof.text: The common-stage descent lemma now applies to these coherent $\alpha,\beta$. Its arrow prescription defines the fibre on $[M,u]$ and every object in the isomorphism closure of heart pairs. Its finite-stage kernel/cokernel and exactness descent assertions give exactness, joint conservativity, zero-map and short-exact detection. Its final comparison identifies the descended maps with the actual common-stage pullback.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; common-stage heart and fibre descent

proof.text: Apply the rank-refinement lemma to each finite-stage object and then to a representative of each common-stage object. Its local rank equals normalized fibre dimension, is independent of the geometric point over the underlying point, and has finite range. Its clopen rank refinements give the required finite stratification and constructible positive-rank locus; its scalar and common-stage assertions give every remaining invariance claim.
